meta.title: Imbra — Software & Industrial Engineering
meta.description: Imbra is a one-engineer software consultancy for industrial companies — building, integrating, and supporting the software between plant floor and IT.

hero.headline: Complex inside.
hero.sub: A one-engineer software consultancy for industrial companies. We build, integrate, and support the software between plant floor and IT — protocol stacks and test tooling, data integration and historians, the legacy systems nobody else will touch — on published rates or at a fixed price.

services.label: 01 — Services
services.heading: What we
services.sub: Expand a service: the problem, what we do about it, and where we have done it before.

founder.lead: All six are delivered by one engineer:
founder.name: Branimir Georgiev
founder.span: nine years of DCS and PLC logic in a chemical plant, then protocol stacks, test frameworks and historian software for automation vendors and plants.

footer.about: Based in Varna, Bulgaria (EU, CET+1), working remotely across Europe. Every engagement is fully documented — architecture, runbooks, and source code are client-owned and transferable. Where it is going: an affordable, open ecosystem for plant data — from the protocol stack to the historian — built by Imbra, owned by the plants that run it.
